question: Can the time an issue's title or body last changed be read, apart from the time anything on it changed; and each reopening, with who did it?
pass: Yes to both (section 6): on an issue whose body was edited, then its title, then commented on, labelled, closed and reopened, each a minute apart by the Maintainer, the read gives a time for the content's last change that is the title's edit and not the comment's, the label's, the close's or the reopening's, apart from updatedAt, which is the reopening's; and the timeline's ReopenedEvent names the Maintainer and when. The acts and their minutes, from the trial's own log: created 21:15:16Z; body edited 21:16:22Z; title edited 21:17:28Z; commented 21:18:34Z; labelled 21:19:42Z; closed 21:20:48Z; reopened 21:21:54Z.
